title: PostgreSQL + Prisma — Data Modeling, SQL, and Migrations
description: Learn the database independently, then use Prisma without surrendering understanding of SQL and migration risk.

example.code:
model Task {
  id          String    @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  title       String
  done        Boolean   @default(false)
  workspaceId String    @db.Uuid
  workspace   Workspace @relation(fields: [workspaceId], references: [id])
}
example.expected: Prisma Client exposes typed operations while PostgreSQL still enforces relational constraints.

lessons.breakIt: Model everything as optional strings and identify the domain guarantees you lost.
